description: Rocca, 23-year-old female mechanic. Dark brown skin, light brown eyes, very short pale sandy cropped hair. Five heads tall, broad shoulders, muscular forearms, sturdy legs. Grape-purple work overalls, short ivory canvas waist apron, square knee patches, broad safety boots. Small inspection hammer at HER left hip. Feet spread, one hand on hip, warm confident smile. No armor or oversized weapon.
